params.name: window_seconds
params.description: Window for the ``in_window`` counts, measured from ``created_at``.

items.docs:
Return per-status (and per-action) row counts for the calling client.

The query is two ``GROUP BY`` selects against ``api_requests``:

1. Status totals across all rows belonging to the client (cheap; the
   table is partitioned by client in production and ``status`` is
   cardinality-bounded).
2. Status × action totals filtered to ``created_at >= now() - window``
   (uses the existing ``(client, created_at)`` index).

Both queries are read-only and idempotent — safe to poll at 1 Hz.
